title: The ambiguity of choice
paragraphs: Choice is often invoked as evidence of autonomy.
Yet an abundance of alternatives does not necessarily confer meaningful control.
When the terms of selection are opaque, apparent freedom may coexist with considerable dependence.
The issue, then, is not merely how many options exist, but how intelligible their consequences are.
